title: LLM Proteomics Hallucination Study: Evaluating Factual Accuracy in AI-Generated Proteomics Information
description: A prospective evaluation study assessing hallucination rates in large language model (LLM) responses to proteomics-related queries. This repository contains all code, data, and analysis for the manuscript submitted to The Lancet Digital Health.

creators.name: Laitinen Imanov, Olaf Yunus
creators.affiliation: Technical University of Denmark, Department of Health Technology

notes: This dataset accompanies the manuscript 'Evaluating Hallucinations in Large Language Model Responses to Proteomics Queries: A Prospective Study' submitted to The Lancet Digital Health. It includes 500 unique queries, 1,500 LLM responses (GPT-4 Turbo, Claude 3 Sonnet, Gemini Pro 1.5), expert annotations, ground truth data, analysis code, and manuscript figures. Overall hallucination rate: 31.2% (95% CI: 28.7-33.8%).
method: Prospective evaluation study with stratified random sampling, expert dual annotation (Cohen's kappa = 0.89), statistical analysis using chi-square tests and logistic regression with Bonferroni correction.
